title: PCD : GIS Snapshots
content: PCD: GIS Snapshots Print Minus Related Pages Geographic Information Systems (GIS) are powerful tools for enhancing the surveillance, prevention, and treatment of chronic diseases. PCD GIS Snapshots enable public health professionals to demonstrate the diverse uses of GIS to efficiently and innovatively improve chronic disease prevention and health promotion.
